rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dropper {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common CobaltStrike beacon loader patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malware_family = "CobaltStrike"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 6A 00 68 [2] 00 00 68 [2] 00 00 E8 [4] 83 C4 0C 85 C0 75 } 
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" 
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" 
    condition:
        all of ($beacon*) and $http_get and $user_agent
}

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects configuration block within Cobalt Strike Beacon payloads"
        author = "SOC Threat Intel Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $config_start = { 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 }
        $beacon_url = "http" fullword ascii
        $cfg_xormagic = "!!!" # Common XOR key indicator
    condition:
        $config_start at 0x40 and 2 of ($beacon_url, $cfg_xormagic)
}

arguments.summary: An emergency access request from IP 10.0.5.14 triggered a high-severity alert. Firewall rules have been updated to block outbound traffic to the C2 IP.
